name: MakeInspires STEAM Summer Camp Mamaroneck
description_short: Weekly STEAM camp at the MakeInspires makerspace in Mamaroneck for ages 5 to 15, in groups of up to seven, with robotics, stop motion, engineering, rocketry, 3D printing, Minecraft and game design. Half day morning or afternoon, or full day 9:30 to 3:30, with optional specialty weeks for full day campers.

fees.name: Catered lunch
fees.note: Full day campers only, 12 to 1 pm

notes: 2027 registration is open: half day morning (9:30 to 12) $540 a week, full day (9:30 to 3:30) $925 a week; an afternoon half day (1 to 3:30) is offered but its price is not printed. Optional expert weeks for full day campers cost $100 to $250 extra (woodworking, drones, FIRST LEGO League, Python, soldering, Dungeons and Dragons, fashion tech, Roblox). 20% off with a promo code until November 30, 2026. Sibling discounts 10% to 30%; campers aged 14 get 25% off and 15 get 50% off as CITs.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Mamaroneck STEAM Summer Camp page under '2027 Registration': 12 weekly sessions 'Jun 15 to Sep 9', ages 5 to 15, half day AM $540/wk, full day $925/wk, catered lunch +$50/wk, expert session +$150 to $250. The expert weeks are dated July 13 to 17 through August 31 to September 4, which are Monday to Friday weeks in 2026, not 2027, so no sessions and no expert week fees are recorded.

source.title: STEM SUMMER MAMARONECK | MakeInspires STEAM Makerspaces

for_andrew: The page heads '2027 Registration' but its expert week dates are 2026 weekdays and the 'Jun 15 to Sep 9' range fits neither year. Draft keeps the 2027 prices and leaves out the dates and expert week add ons. OK?
